Ps.1.6.text: For those God foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, so that He would be the firstborn among many brothers.
Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
But the one who loves God is known by God.
The LORD detests the way of the wicked, but He loves those who pursue righteousness.

Ps.1.1.text: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.
Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.
He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
I never sat with the band of revelers, nor did I celebrate with them. Because Your hand was on me, I sat alone, for You have filled me with indignation.

Ps.19.1.text: For what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.
When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—
For since the creation of the world God’s invisible qualities, His eternal power and divine nature, have been clearly seen, being understood from His workmanship, so that men are without excuse.
And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah

Ps.19.2.text: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.

1Sam.15.29.text: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?
“Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
I, the LORD, have spoken; the time is coming, and I will act. I will not refrain or show pity, nor will I relent. I will judge you according to your ways and deeds,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
